rationale: Class 3 aggregate flag. Raw filing source was checked through the evidence CLI. The filing's schedule reports Total Investments of $35,500,450 thousand and 185.4% of net assets at table 37 row 24, but no raw-source row contains the flagged 36.9% value, and the bundle provides no detail row or issuer for the single alleged >25% outlier. The source therefore does not identify which position or field produced the derived pct_sum, so a real error or false alarm cannot be grounded without guessing.
